sample_unit: ENT UK leaflets paired with ChatGPT responses (topics)

links.outcome: Readability of ChatGPT patient information versus ENT UK leaflets
links.effect: ChatGPT responses had reduced readability and required a higher reading age than professionally produced ENT UK leaflets; the abstract reports mean readability of ENT UK leaflets as higher than ChatGPT responses.
links.quote: ChatGPT patient information and professionally produced leaflets had comparable content, but large language model content required a higher reading age.

screen.reason: Evaluates the quality and readability of ChatGPT-generated patient education materials compared to ENT UK leaflets without testing an organizational deployment safeguard or practice.
